name: mise
description: MCP add-on for Alexa+: pantry by voice, weekly plan from what you have, resumable cooking sessions, curated substitutions, UCP checkout. Deterministic server, no LLM of its own.

scripts.validate: python3 scripts/validate_recipes.py data/recipes && python3 scripts/validate_recipes.py --staging data/imports && python3 scripts/validate_substitutions.py && python3 scripts/validate_catalog.py && python3 scripts/validate_shelf_life.py && python3 scripts/validate_scaling.py && python3 scripts/validate_nutrition.py && python3 scripts/validate_long_steps.py
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate
